name: Checkpoint

test_list.description: Completed and interrupted states round-trip without refunding reservations.
Every truncated prefix and extra trailing data fails closed.
Malformed counts, non-finite metrics, and inconsistent accounting are rejected.

inputs.name: bytes
inputs.description: Versioned checkpoint bytes bounded to 32 MiB.

output_description: Validated recovery state; the storage owner must authenticate its content ID.
